user_query: trass gmail entries with term mgm in april 2025

intent.goal: find gmail entries containing mgm in trass workspace during april 2025

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR g.recipient_emails LIKE '%mgm%'
)
AND (
    strftime('%Y-%m', g.email_date) = '2025-04'
    OR strftime('%Y-%m', u.created_time) = '2025-04'
)
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200;
